overview.about: The FedEx St. Jude Championship is the first event of the PGA Tour's FedExCup Playoffs, played at TPC Southwind in Memphis. Only the season's top players qualify, and it begins the three-event run that decides the FedExCup and its huge bonus, while supporting St. Jude Children's Research Hospital.
overview.nextEvent: The next FedEx St. Jude Championship is played at TPC Southwind in Memphis, Tennessee. As the opening playoff event, a strong field competes to advance toward the Tour Championship and the FedExCup title.
